message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s). Facts: Zhang stole a phone with a knife. Next day, Gu (defendant) knowingly bought the phone, knowing its source unknown, i.e., proceeds of crime. That's concealment/cover-up of criminal proceeds: "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得罪" (concealing/obscuring criminal proceeds). According to correction rules: when listing crime name(s) between [罪名] and <eoa>, output only the statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we should output "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得". Also need to consider if there is also "盗窃"? The defendant is Gu, not the thief. Gu's conduct is only concealment. So single offense.

Thus final answer: [罪名]掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得<eoa>
